meta.description: Diagnose and fix broken ruflo plugins

user.t:
You are hive agent "plugin-medic" (a ruflo plugin-developer) in a hybrid hive. Read C:[REDACTED:high_entropy].md and BUS.md, then post on BUS.md what you will change. Peers: sona-trainer (trains SONA, so coordinate on anything SONA-related), vector-lab (owns ruvector fixes; do NOT touch ruvector), plus ingestor, llm-smith, mesh-coder and ecosystem-scout.

User request: "fix the ruflo plugins that don't work. Focus on agents, swarms and hive mind, and the intelligence plugins that train SONA."

Scope: the ruflo plugins under C:/Users/mariu/.claude/plugins (cache/ruflo/*, synced/*ruflo*, marketplaces/ruflo, which is a git clone) and the ruflo CLI the MCP server actually runs: C:[REDACTED:high_entropy]@claude-flow/cli. First work out which copy of each plugin Claude Code actually loads (check ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json and the settings).

Known problems to verify, and fix where it's our side:
1. The npm build of @claude-flow/cli 3.56.3 lacks dist/assets/model-router/* (seed corpus). It is worked around today via env vars in ~/.claude/settings.json pointing into marketplaces/ruflo/v3/.../assets. Decide whether copying the assets into dist is cleaner.
2. `hooks model-route` (CLI) never passes an embedding, so the neural router never runs from the CLI path.
3. SONA has 0 trajectories: nothing wires trajectory-start/step/end or model-outcome into real work. Check what the ruflo-core hooks (hook-handler.cjs, .claude/helpers, the UserPromptSubmit "Routing task" banner) actually do, and whether a SessionEnd/PostToolUse(Task) hook should record outcomes. Do NOT install hooks into settings yourself: write the exact hook config and hand it to the queen.
4. The AgentDB bridge said "not available"; agentdb@3.0.0-alpha.20 has since been installed next to the CLI. Verify it by importing the bridge module directly in a node script with the same env. Do not restart Claude Code.
5. The user saw "58 errors during load" on /reload-plugins. Find the plugin manifest or skill/agent frontmatter errors among the ruflo plugins (agents, swarm, hive-mind, intelligence, agentdb, core). Validate them (plugin.json, agents/*.md frontmatter, skills SKILL.md frontmatter, commands, hooks.json) and fix ours. List the non-ruflo errors you see, but don't fix those.
6. swarm_init / hive-mind_init persist state, but agents spawned through Claude Code's Task tool don't register in that swarm. Check whether the ruflo agent templates (ruflo-agent nested-queen etc.) are broken or just unwired, and fix whatever is actually broken.

Safety rules:
- Before editing any file, copy the original to C:/Users/mariu/.claude/plugin-patches/originals/<same relative path>.
- Write each fix as a unified diff in C:/Users/mariu/.claude/plugin-patches/patches/.
- Write C:/Users/mariu/.claude/plugin-patches/apply.ps1, which re-applies all patches idempotently after a plugin update (check before patching, and skip if already applied).
- Write README.md there listing each problem → cause → fix → how verified.
- Never weaken a security check.
- Never git push or open issues/PRs upstream; just draft the upstream bug texts in README.md.
- Prefer config/env fixes over code edits.
- Verify every fix by actually running the affected command or MCP-equivalent code path.
- Report anything that only takes effect after a Claude Code restart.

Return ≤ 30 lines: each problem → verdict (fixed / worked around / upstream-only / not reproducible), with evidence.

handback.t:
plugin-medic report. Full write-up with upstream bug drafts: C:/Users/mariu/.claude/plugin-patches/README.md. Patches are in patches/02..06, copies of originals in originals/, re-apply with apply.ps1 (idempotent, -Status reports only). My writes to the npx cache and plugin-patches were NOT denied by the permission classifier.

Which copy loads: every ruflo plugin loads from ~/.claude/plugins/cache/ruflo/<name>/<ver>. settings.json and installed_plugins.json now list 45 ruflo plugins enabled at user scope (earlier reads showed 7). The marketplaces/ruflo git clone is only the update source, and I did not edit it. The MCP server runs @claude-flow/cli 3.56.3 from npx cache 85fb20e3e7e3a233.

1. model-router assets: FIXED. Copying into dist/assets/model-router is cleaner than the env vars. With CLAUDE_FLOW_ROUTER_SEED_CORPUS and CLAUDE_FLOW_ROUTER_MODEL_PATH unset, `neural router status` shows the bundled KRR, 3 bucket specialists and calibrators loaded. The two env vars are now redundant; keep only CLAUDE_FLOW_ROUTER_NEURAL=1.
2. `hooks model-route` never ran the neural router: FIXED, with two causes. (a) The handler never passed an embedding to route(). (b) task-embedder always returned undefined because @xenova/transformers cannot load (nested sharp@0.32 has no win32 binary), and a failed xenova import makes generateLocalEmbedding return 'mock'. I patched hooks-tools.js and task-embedder.js (local ONNX MiniLM first). `hooks model-route --format json` now returns routedBy:"hybrid" with a modelId, where before it was heuristic only.
3. SONA with 0 trajectories: DIAGNOSED, config written, NOT installed. No shipped hook calls trajectory-* or model-outcome. ruflo-core hooks.json has no UserPromptSubmit or SessionEnd hook, and hook-handler.cjs only calls a local feedback(). The "Routing task" banner is the static keyword router in ruflo-mods, advisory only. I wrote hooks/sona-hooks.cjs and hooks/settings-hooks.json (UserPromptSubmit start, PostToolUse Task|Agent step, PostToolUseFailure counter, Stop end + model-outcome). Piping synthetic hook payloads into the script in a throwaway dir recorded the trajectory, the step, the end and a model-outcome call; the CLI reported SONA learned the pattern (globalStatsTrajectoriesDelta 1). It needs `memory init` in the project first. It prints nothing and adds about 30 ms per hook. Outcome labels are a proxy (success unless 3 or more tool failures in the turn), so you decide whether to merge the snippet into settings.json.
4. AgentDB bridge: UPSTREAM-ONLY. It is not waiting for a restart. memory-bridge.js hard-disables it on win32 (#3024). Forcing CLAUDE_FLOW_ENABLE_NATIVE_BRIDGE_ON_WINDOWS=1 with agentdb 3.0.0-alpha.20 aborts node ("memory allocation of ~4.1-4.4 GB failed", reproduced twice). Do not set that variable. Use memory_* instead of agentdb_*.
5. "58 errors during load": FIXED for ruflo. Only 2 ruflo defects (`claude plugin validate` plus my frontmatter check): unquoted ": " in the description of ruflo-cost-tracker 0.28.0 skills/cost-openrouter and ruflo-metaharness 0.2.5 skills/harness-threat-model. Fixed in the cache copies and both now validate. The marketplace clone still has them, so they return on the next version bump until upstream fixes them. All other ruflo plugin.json, agents, commands, skills and hooks.json pass.
   Non-ruflo errors seen, not fixed (partial scan, 7 plugins of ~1600 synced bundles still being checked in the background): 12 official LSP plugins (clangd, csharp, gopls, jdtls, kotlin, lua, php, pyright, ruby, rust-analyzer, swift, typescript); 2 synced plugins with PreToolUse/PermissionRequest declared outside "hooks"; corivo (plugin.json path under .md files); a marketplace named "cargo" (reserved name); one with plugins.0.source Invalid input; one with owner missing.
6. Task-tool agents not in the swarm: FIXED in the template text, and the cause was both broken and unwired. Task never calls ruflo, and the nested-queen* pseudocode used argument names the MCP schemas reject (hive-mind_spawn role "queen", consensus without action, claims_* without issueId, aidefence content vs input, trajectory-step/end without trajectoryId). I added an authoritative MCP argument contract plus "register each Task child with agent_spawn / agent_update / hive-mind_join" to the 4 queen-family agents, and added the missing tools to their tool lists. Checked in a throwaway dir: agent_spawn with swarmId gave agentCount 1, hive-mind_join made the worker show in hive-mind_status, and consensus propose with bft works. The patched plugin validates.

Needs a Claude Code restart: the running ruflo MCP server picking up #2 (fresh CLI calls already have it), and the patched plugin/agent text for #5 and #6. #3 does nothing until you merge the hook snippet.

Files: patches in C:/Users/mariu/.claude/plugin-patches/patches/ (02..06), apply.ps1, README.md, assets/model-router/, hooks/sona-hooks.cjs, hooks/settings-hooks.json. Patched: dist/src/ruvector/task-embedder.js and dist/src/mcp-tools/hooks-tools.js under C:[REDACTED:high_entropy]@claude-flow/cli, plus the ruflo-agent 0.3.2, ruflo-cost-tracker 0.28.0 and ruflo-metaharness 0.2.5 cache dirs. A sandbox copy of the test state remains in %TEMP%\sbx. An early run of apply.ps1 also patched an older CLI copy (_npx/2ed56890c96f58f7, v3.51.1); I reverted it to pristine and apply.ps1 now patches only the newest CLI unless -AllCli is given.
